Hi Alicia — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can align the commercial path and the trial success criteria before we spin up the dedicated sandbox: 

1) Procurement routing: can you confirm whether Starlit will pay via Purchase Order (PO) or company card? If PO, who is the procurement contact and do you have an internal vendor set-up form we should expect?

2) Marketplace: you mentioned a possible interest in buying through the Cloud Marketplace later. Is that a firm requirement for go-live or just a future preference? If it's a must-have, we should note that in the pilot acceptance criteria.

3) Trial -> paid triggers: we propose a billing start when either (a) the pilot exceeds 50k tokens in a 7-day window or (b) the pilot end date (30 days) is reached — whichever comes first. Does that align with your finance team's requirements?

4) Success criteria: you called out latency < 250ms P95 for inference, 95% availability during business hours, and >70% accuracy on the intent classifier for your core flows. Confirm if any of these should be added/changed.

Next steps we suggested on the call (mutual action plan):
- You: confirm procurement path and attach vendor set-up form (if PO).
- Redwood (me/Karthik): share SOW draft, ROI worksheet, and estimate for expected token usage during pilot.
- Vanessa (ops): if procurement is PO, please advise on payment terms we can offer and any discount guardrails.

I'm attaching the ROI_worksheet.xlsx for your team to sketch expected traffic, and a short SOW draft for scope and timeline. Happy to jump on a quick call with procurement if helpful.

Best,

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear recap. A few answers from our side: 

- Procurement path: Starlit prefers PO for all new platform vendors. I've looped in our procurement mailbox (procurement@starlit.ai). Our procurement team typically requires a vendor form + W9 and a draft SOW. I'll upload the vendor form; attaching the standard procurement checklist for your reference (procurement-questions.pdf).

- Payment terms: Finance will typically request Net 30 from the invoice date. We can discuss net 45 for pilots if needed, but that's not guaranteed.

- Marketplace: this is not mandatory for initial go-live — it's a strategic preference for later purchasing (Q3 consideration). Not a blocker for the pilot.

- Billing trigger: PO + net30 is fine. For the pilot, finance prefers we get invoiced only after a formal acceptance sign-off (SOW acceptance) or when usage breaches agreed thresholds. The 50k tokens / 7-day trigger could work, but procurement wants it reflected in the SOW as a clear trigger event.

I can share the procurement contact name and vendor form tomorrow morning. If you can get the SOW and invoice cadence language updated to show the token trigger and acceptance milestone, we can move quickly.

Thanks,

Jordan — thanks for the forward. Quick answers from ops/finance perspective: 

- Payment terms: we can support Net 30 for Starlit. For pilot courtesy, we can extend to Net 45 but only if procurement signs the SOW and their vendor form is completed before pilot start. That should be acceptable to Alicia's team.

- Pilot discount: standard pilot discount is 15% off our list inference rate for first 30 days. Any deviation requires manager approval.

- Billing trigger: include explicit language in the SOW: 
  • "Billing for the Pilot will commence upon the earlier of (i) the Pilot exceeding fifty thousand (50,000) generated tokens in any seven (7) day window; or (ii) the Pilot end date as specified in the SOW."
  • Also add an acceptance milestone with a named Starlit approver (Alicia — your confirmation on approver name is needed).

- Marketplace: Karthik, please provide a short timeline. If listing requires a contract addendum, highlight that so we can route legal early.

I'll have finance draft the invoice template and the net45 pilot approval paperwork by EOD. Jordan — once you send SOW v2 with the billing clause, I'll route to legal for a quick one-page review.
